answer.title: PV inverter and DC field failure modes at OUEST1-INV03
answer.synopsis: OUEST1-INV03, a critical asset at Centrale PV Ouest-1, exhibits a higher incident rate compared to the site median, with 36 incidents versus 31.5. The most costly failure mode is wiring degradation and short-circuit, accounting for 34.4% of the equipment's total incident cost, which has been increasing over time. Immediate actions include inspecting cable connections and wiring, cleaning PV modules, and verifying surge protection devices to mitigate the most critical failure modes.
